sum: Compresses tool output, logs, files and RAG chunks before they reach the model.

evidence.co.standards: cites standards_conformance.evidence: conforms to 2 of the 5 neutral interface standards (MCP, Agent Plugins)
evidence.se.residency: cites data_residency: local-first, the operator's state stays on their machine
evidence.se.threats: cites th and ctrl: T2 introduced, controls log part
evidence.fx.exit: artifact.format ephemeral-path: a path that exists for the run; nothing durable survives it
evidence.pe.budget: a ceiling the operator sets on the command line: headroom/proxy/server.py (--limit-concurrency)
evidence.co.coexist: states the hosts it sits beside: Claude Code, Cursor, Aider, OpenCode, Cline, GitHub Copilot, Codex CLI, Zed, OpenAI Codex (README.md)
evidence.ic.help: a command-line parser that prints its own usage: Cargo.toml (clap)
evidence.ic.error: a documented flag that gates or previews the action: docs/content/docs/configuration.mdx (--dry-run)
evidence.rl.resume: a resume the operator can ask for: wiki/cli.md (--resume)
evidence.se.attest: signs or attests what it publishes: .github/workflows/docker.yml (cosign)
evidence.fx.install: an install that does not change the machine globally: README.md (uv tool install)
evidence.fx.byo: the provider is the operator's choice: BEDROCK, LITELLM, OPENROUTER, OLLAMA (README.md)
evidence.sf.stop: a stop path, and the state it leaves behind is described: e2e/wrap/run.py (SIGINT); README.md (Ctrl+C)
evidence.sf.warn: the irreversible step is both warned about and gated: wiki/configuration.md (overwrites the)

anti: audit work that requires complete output
gnote: Compression can drop something that mattered; visibility into what was discarded is required
